Frontend: All major user flows tested and working correctly including homepage, shop, product detail, cart, checkout, login, and account pages.

minor_issues.issue: Returns 405 Method Not Allowed instead of 401 Unauthorized
minor_issues.impact: Minor - both indicate the request cannot proceed, but 401 is more semantically correct

minor_issues.issue: Returns 400 'Batas pemakaian voucher ini sudah tercapai' (voucher usage limit reached)
minor_issues.impact: Expected behavior from previous test runs - voucher has usage_limit and it was reached

notes: This is a repo-copy verification task. The app was copied from https://github.com/dawasaraka/cp and all functionality has been verified.
Demo data is seeded with 12 products, 6 categories, 18 reviews, 5 active vouchers, 2 test users (admin and customer).
Stripe and Google API keys are intentionally NOT configured - manual payment proof upload and embed/manual store reviews are the expected fallback (not bugs).
All backend routes correctly use /api prefix for Kubernetes ingress routing.
Frontend uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from .env for all API calls.
The app is fully functional end-to-end with Indonesian language UI.
Product images use generative bottle art (SVG) as fallback when real images are not available.
Voucher system works correctly with percent, flat, and free_shipping types, including scoped vouchers (category/product-specific).
Anti-oversell protection works (quantity > stock returns 409 with available count).
IDOR protection works (non-owner cannot access other user's orders).
Admin backoffice has comprehensive CRUD for products, categories, vouchers, orders, reviews, stores, analytics, CRM, and content management.
